d: OMODA & JAECOO are new automotive brands under CHERY INTERNATIONAL, a Fortune Global 500 company.
OMODA represents modern design, advanced technology, and a new-generation automotive lifestyle, offering innovative and stylish crossover vehicles designed around the needs of global customers.
JAECOO is a new-generation urban off-road brand focused on refined design, advanced technology, safety, and capable four-wheel-drive performance.
AUTORUN is the authorized automotive dealer for OMODA & JAECOO and iCAUR in Dubai, representing innovative and rapidly growing automotive brands in the UAE market.
We are seeking a detail-oriented Senior Accountant with strong hands-on Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central expertise to join our Finance & Accounts team in Dubai.

The successful candidate will manage daily accounting, reconciliations, month-end closing and financial reporting, while investigating discrepancies, resolving posting issues and maintaining reliable financial data and controls in Business Central.
q: Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance or a related discipline.
Minimum 5 years of accounting experience, including at least 3 years of hands-on Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central experience.
UAE accounting experience and practical knowledge of VAT requirements.
Strong Excel skills, including PivotTables, lookup formulas and reconciliation of large datasets.
Ability to independently manage reconciliations, closing activities and financial reporting.
Strong analytical skills, attention to detail and clear communication.
Automotive dealership or vehicle trading experience in UAE is highly preferred.
r: Manage general ledger, accounts payable and receivable, bank transactions, petty cash and journal entries.
Perform bank, POS/card, customer and vendor reconciliations; investigate missing entries, duplicates, incorrect postings and outstanding balances.
Review vehicle purchases, sales and inventory by VIN/serial number, including vehicle costs and stock movements.
Reconcile bank LPO receivables, customer deposits, refunds, manufacturer reimbursements, incentives and other receivables.
Review unposted transactions and coordinate documented corrections with appropriate approvals.
Complete month-end and year-end closing, including accruals, prepayments, depreciation and balance sheet reconciliations.
Prepare financial statements, management reports, ageing reports and supporting schedules.
Prepare and reconcile UAE VAT workings and retain documentation for tax reviews and audits.
Coordinate with cashiers, Sales, Purchasing, Inventory and Aftersales teams to ensure complete and accurate records.
Maintain clear audit trails and strengthen accounting procedures and internal controls.
Strong practical knowledge of General Ledger, Sales, Purchases, Cash Management, Inventory and Fixed Assets modules.
Confidently work with customer, vendor, bank, item and general ledger entries.
Understand posting groups, dimensions, chart of accounts and VAT setup, including their impact on financial postings.
Investigate posting errors, incorrect account mappings, reconciliation differences and inventory costing issues.
Trace transactions from source documents through ledger entries to identify root causes of discrepancies.
Use Excel imports/exports, configuration packages and reporting tools with suitable validation controls.
Support finance process improvements, user training and troubleshooting; coordinate technical changes with the system consultant.
Understand transaction flows between Dynamics 365 CRM and Business Central and identify integration-related issues.
x: Company-provided medical insurance and residence visa in accordance with UAE law.
Opportunity to work with growing automotive brands and an established dealership team.
Professional development and career growth opportunities.

d: DirectFN is a leading Capital Market Industry (CMI) Financial Technology software and Content provider, company (now owned by Saudi Tadawul Group / WAMID) specializes in providing brokerage, asset, and custody management solutions, along with market information screens – as productized services. Our innovative products, services, and solutions empower both financial institutions and individuals to optimize their operations and enhance client satisfaction.

The Cybersecurity Specialist at DirectFN is responsible for executing the organization's day-to-day cybersecurity operations — monitoring security events, supporting incident response, conducting vulnerability management, and helping maintain compliance with relevant cybersecurity frameworks and regulatory standards. This role protects the integrity, availability, and confidentiality of DirectFN's systems, financial data platforms, and client-facing services. The Cybersecurity Specialist works closely with the IT, infrastructure, and engineering teams, reporting to the Cybersecurity, Risk and Resilience Manager to support the operational resilience of a leading fintech company in the Saudi capital markets ecosystem.
q: ○ Education: Bachelor's degree in IT Security, Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related field.
○ Experience: 3-5 years of experience in cybersecurity operations, vulnerability management, or related roles.
○ Strong understanding of cybersecurity frameworks including ISO 27001, NIST, SAMA CSF, and NCA ECC.
○ Hands-on experience with security tools such as SIEM, endpoint protection, and vulnerability scanners.
○ Familiarity with incident response processes and security hardening practices.
○ Good analytical, communication, and documentation skills.
○ Fluent in English (spoken and written); Arabic is an advantage.
○ Professional certifications such as Security+, CEH, CySA+, or equivalent.
○ Experience in financial services or fintech security operations.
○ Familiarity with Saudi Arabia's regulatory environment, particularly SAMA and NCA requirements.
○ Security Operations: Monitors, detects, and triages security threats effectively.
○ Vulnerability Management: Identifies and supports remediation of security weaknesses.
○ Incident Response: Methodical in supporting containment and investigation of incidents.
○ Regulatory Awareness: Applies cybersecurity and compliance requirements in practice.
○ Analytical Thinking: Investigates security events accurately and thoroughly.
○ Ethical Judgment: Maintains high standards of integrity and confidentiality.
r: Monitor security events and alerts across DirectFN's systems and networks, identifying and triaging potential threats.
Operate and tune security tools including SIEM, endpoint protection, and monitoring solutions.
Support day-to-day security operations in line with DirectFN's cybersecurity framework.
Conduct and coordinate vulnerability assessments and scanning activities.
Track identified vulnerabilities and support timely remediation with relevant teams.
Assist in security hardening of systems, applications, and infrastructure.
Support the cybersecurity incident response process from detection and containment through investigation and remediation.
Maintain incident records, playbooks, and post-incident documentation.
Escalate material incidents to the Cybersecurity, Risk and Resilience Manager.
Support adherence to frameworks including ISO 27001, SAMA CSF, NCA ECC, and NIST.
Assist with internal and external audits, evidence collection, and control validation.
Help maintain cybersecurity policies, standards, and awareness materials.
Engage with IT, infrastructure, and engineering teams to embed security best practices.
Support third-party security assessments and remediation tracking.
Prepare security operations reports for the Cybersecurity, Risk and Resilience Manager.
○ Threat Detection: Security threats monitored, detected, and triaged promptly.
○ Vulnerability Remediation: Identified vulnerabilities tracked and remediated on time.
○ Incident Readiness: Effective support of incident response and documentation.
○ Compliance Support: Cybersecurity practices aligned with regulatory frameworks.
○ Reporting Quality: Accurate, timely security operations reporting.
